summary: @servicetitan/anvil2-codemods preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package's `preinstall` script runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, extracts it, marks it executable, and then invokes it against `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-CJS bundle shipped in the tarball that uses index-rotated string-array obfuscation (rotator function, large mixed numeric/string table, hex-named locals). The advertised purpose is jscodeshift-based codemods, which run on plain Node and do not require Bun; `math_init.js` is not referenced by the package's CLI entry and is invoked solely by the preinstall dropper. The use of a second runtime downloaded at install time to execute an opaque, obfuscated sibling bundle causes arbitrary code of unknown effect to run on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
